name: Anatomy Cube
summary:
Anatomy Cube puts a life-size human body in your room, in mixed reality, or in a gallery, under a night sky or at dusk.

The body is a light glass skeleton. Carry a lens through it: a box, sphere, octahedron, dodecahedron or slice shows the full-detail anatomy inside, from about 3,500 named structures. Choose the tissues, styles and colours.

HOW IT WORKS: narrated sequences on the real anatomy - the senses, the heartbeat, breathing, the blood's round trip, reflexes, swallowing, moving the arm.

SENSORS: ho
